meaning:
A man of the tribe of Reuben living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.6;
son of: Baal (H1168)
§ Beerah = "well"
a Reubenite chief exiled to Assyria

elsewhere.note: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.
